title: UFO 'like a rainbow' spotted streaking across night sky
excerpt: Multiple streaks of light have been seen moving across the night sky.
content:
Multiple streaks of light have been seen moving across the night sky.

The unexplained lights were spotted above Hereford by two residents, Karl Davis and Terri Michelle Edkins, on separate evenings this month.

Mr Davis witnessed the phenomenon on September 15, while Mrs Edkins saw the lights on September 12.

Both described seeing multiple streaks of light moving through the sky, with Mrs Edkins' family commenting on the unusual display during a video recording.

Mrs Edkins' family said: "It's actually shining different colours. It's actually shining red and blue.

"It's like a rainbow.

"It's weird."

Unidentified flying objects (UFOs), also referred to as unidentified aerial phenomena (UAPs), are objects or lights observed in the sky that have not been immediately identified or explained.

The Herefordshire county town of Leominster was rated as one of the country's UFO hotspots back in October 2025.

Another image of the lights beaming across Hereford. (Image: Karl Davis)

While most UFO sightings are later attributed to known objects or natural phenomena, a small number remain unexplained.

UFO sightings have been recorded throughout history, with notable increases in reports following the Second World War and during the early years of the Space Age.

Governments and organisations around the world have conducted investigations into UFO sightings, but none have confirmed claims of extraterrestrial origin.

Despite this, popular culture and media have fuelled ongoing public interest and speculation about the possibility of alien life.

Scientists and sceptical organisations, including the Committee for Skeptical Inquiry, generally attribute UFO sightings to misidentified natural or man-made objects, optical illusions, or deliberate hoaxes.

Nonetheless, a significant portion of the public continues to express belief in the existence of UFOs and the possibility of extraterrestrial visitors.

Public fascination with UFOs has inspired elements of folklore, new religious movements, and numerous works of fiction.
